messaging.channels.title: Messaging channels
messaging.channels.description: Choose which channels deliver messages to customers and your team. Connect your own Netgsm or Twilio account for SMS; one SMS provider can be active at a time.
messaging.channels.whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
messaging.channels.whatsapp.subtitle: Your own number or the platform number
messaging.channels.whatsapp.description: Job, contract, sale and quote notifications go out over WhatsApp. Pair your own number with a QR code on the Connection tab.
messaging.channels.email.title: E-mail
messaging.channels.email.subtitle: Through the platform
messaging.channels.email.description: Quote and team notifications are e-mailed through the platform's delivery service; no setup needed.
messaging.channels.sms.title: SMS – {{provider}}
messaging.sms.providers.netgsm.name: Netgsm
messaging.sms.providers.netgsm.subtitle: Turkey
messaging.sms.providers.netgsm.descripti: Send SMS from your approved message header (sender name) with your Netgsm account. Turkish characters use Netgsm's Turkish encoding.
messaging.sms.providers.netgsm.form_hint: Enter the subscriber number (user code), API password and approved message header from your Netgsm panel. If API access is IP-restricted, allow our server IP.
messaging.sms.providers.twilio.name: Twilio
messaging.sms.providers.twilio.subtitle: International
messaging.sms.providers.twilio.descripti: Send SMS to international numbers with your Twilio account. Use a Twilio number, an alphanumeric sender id or a Messaging Service SID as the sender.
messaging.sms.providers.twilio.form_hint: Enter the Account SID and Auth Token from the Twilio Console. They are encrypted for your business only and never shown again.
messaging.sms.sender.msgheader_hint: Your approved Netgsm sender name (e.g. COMPANY).
messaging.sms.sender.from_hint: Twilio number (+1…), alphanumeric sender id or Messaging Service SID (MG…).
messaging.sms.form.keep_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the saved value
messaging.sms.form.activate_hint: SMS notifications are sent through this provider.
messaging.sms.form.activate_switch_hint: Turning it on deactivates the other SMS provider.
messaging.sms.test.title: Test SMS with {{provider}}
messaging.sms.test.description: Send a test message to a number to verify the connection. It appears in the delivery log.
messaging.sms.test.phone_hint: Turkish numbers as 05…, others with the country code (+44…).
messaging.sms.test.default_body: Otopoly test message: your SMS channel works.
messaging.sms.disconnect.title: Disconnect {{provider}}?
messaging.sms.disconnect.body: The saved credentials are deleted. If this provider is active, SMS notifications stop.
messaging.sms.use_as_channel_hint: When on, SMS notifications go through this provider.
messaging.sms.toast.save_failed: Could not save the SMS provider
messaging.sms.segments.ucs2_hint: Emoji or special characters cut an SMS part to 70 characters.
messaging.rules.sms_needs_provider: For SMS, connect and activate an SMS provider on the Channels tab first.
messaging.channel_picker.label: Delivery channel
messaging.channel_picker.hint: SMS is sent through your active SMS provider.
messaging.channel_picker.sms_unavailable: Connect Netgsm or Twilio on the Channels tab to use SMS.
messaging.channel_picker.sms_not_ready: No active SMS provider. Connect and activate Netgsm or Twilio on the Channels tab.
messaging.errors.sms_rejected: The SMS provider rejected the message
messaging.errors.sms_outcome_unknown: The SMS provider did not answer; the message may have been sent
messaging.errors.sms_feature_not_entitle: SMS sending is not included in your plan
messaging.channels.read_only: Only the business owner can change channel settings.
